title: Evil and Suffering
summary: Placeholder framing for the response to the problem of evil. Replace with your own writing.

argument.conclusion: The existence of evil and suffering is not, in the end, incompatible with the existence of an all-good, all-powerful God.

premises.text: The presence of evil does not logically rule out God's existence, since a good God could have morally sufficient reasons for permitting it.
Human free will, and a world governed by consistent natural laws, requires the possibility of suffering.

objections.text: Couldn't an all-powerful God have created a world with free will but without so much unnecessary suffering?
